name: Fictional F40 glass diagnostic corridor
purpose: Exercise the environment profile contract with a restrained asymmetric exterior corridor; this is executable documentation, not retained F40 evidence.
ownership: Nishita World owns far-field clear-sky radiance
a separate Sun light is planned to own direct shadows after calibration
finite wall and vegetation proxies own near-field reflection bands
a bounded volume owns optional local haze
the road owns lower-hemisphere geometry and visible ground

world.lighting_owner: far-field sky only; direct solar ownership remains unresolved until contribution testing

sun_elevation.notes: Choose only after the windshield defect is isolated under neutral broad lighting.

air.notes: Not mapped to pressure or molecular density.

dust.notes: Not mapped to aerosol optical depth or PM concentration.

ozone.notes: Not mapped to Dobson units or a vertical ozone profile.

direction.notes: Must match the analytic sky exactly.

angular_size.notes: Match visible disc and shadow softness deliberately.

energy.notes: No artist default accepted before world/direct contribution renders.

density.unit: Blender volume density over a recorded metric bound
density.notes: Default diagnostic state is disabled; any haze must retain a no-volume reference.

visibility_targets.target: black and white contrast target remains distinguishable

road_crown.unit: metres per metre crossfall or explicit profile
road_crown.notes: Must support drainage logic even though this initial profile is dry.

aggregate_scale.notes: Micro-, macro-, and megatexture ownership remain separated.

cloud_state.notes: Clouds are excluded to avoid moving reflection confounders.

precipitation.notes: Wet-weather variants belong to separate profiles.

wind.unit: metres per second in world axes
wind.notes: No particle or vegetation motion in the static defect-isolation profile.

weather.recent_history: Assumed dry and clean for the fictional diagnostic example; no physical weather history is claimed.

exposure.unit: EV offset or explicit camera exposure record
exposure.notes: Fix after the grey-card and sky exposure bracket.

white_balance.notes: Must remain fixed across windshield comparison variants.

camera.display_transform: record exact Blender colour-management configuration before execution

lens.notes: Use at least one deep-focus diagnostic view.

diagnostics: transmission reintroduced after geometry and normal isolation
geometric normals and imported custom loop normals
chrome sphere grey card black-gloss panel and clear-glass proxy
camera orbit to test whether triangular patches remain locked to topology
limitations: No values in this example were measured or executed in Blender.
The profile does not diagnose the user's actual F40 export.
The finite wall vegetation and road geometry are specified only by role.
The deliberately split sun remains unresolved and must not be built from guessed energy values.
